title.zh: Ocean Protocol 数据与算力协议
title.en: Ocean Protocol data and compute protocol

evidence.quote: Ocean is a decentralized data & compute protocol built to scale AI.
Data NFTs & datatokens, to enable token-gated access control, data wallets, data DAOs, and more.
Compute-to-data: buy & sell private data, while preserving privacy

notes.zh: 交集：数据访问控制与 compute-to-data——把计算送到数据所在处，让数据不出域也能参与训练或推理，这是「数据可用不可见」在协议层的一种做法。适用范围：官方把三块列为核心组件（数据 NFT 与 datatoken 做门控访问、compute-to-data 做隐私计算、Ocean Nodes 把闲置算力组网），但这是协议定位说明，没有给出可核的合规结论或性能数字。未解决：代币化门控是否满足各地数据保护法规属于法律判断，不是协议能回答的；本站不评价任何部署效果，也不收录代币价格与收益。
notes.en: The intersection: data access control plus compute-to-data — sending computation to where the data sits so data can take part in training or inference without leaving its domain, one protocol-level approach to "usable but not visible". Scope: the vendor lists three core components (data NFTs and datatokens for token-gated access, compute-to-data for privacy-preserving computation, and Ocean Nodes to network idle compute), but this is a positioning statement without verifiable compliance conclusions or performance figures. Open: whether token-gated access satisfies data protection law in a given jurisdiction is a legal judgement, not something the protocol answers; this entry does not rate any deployment and records no token price or yield.

specs.核心组件 / components: Data NFT 与 datatoken · compute-to-data · Ocean Nodes
specs.隐私机制 / privacy: 计算下沉到数据侧，数据不出域
specs.可核结论 / verifiable claims: 官方页面未给性能或合规结论
